Rotate into CDIA/BRPT for grid-scale exposure, but trim PLUG on US rate sensitivity. Watch for profit-taking after sharp runs; add on pullbacks toward 10-day moving averages.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Digital distribution and direct-to-consumer channels are structurally lifting smaller caps (PADA, SIPD, ZONE), enabling faster shelf-to-market cycles and higher repeat purchase rates.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum names (BIKE, CBUT, POLU) on strong domestic demand and Ramadan tailwinds, but cap exposure given US weakness. Rotate into staples with pricing power (AGAR, ENZO) for defensive carry. Watch for profit-taking after outsized gains; add on dips toward 10-day moving averages.
